# Guanzhi 官制 - 列侯册封效果(头衔版). root=scope:actor(君主), scope:recipient=受封者

# 册封河内王
guanzhi_jue_grant_wang_0000 = {
	save_scope_as = guanzhi_liege
	guanzhi_clear_jue_effect = yes
	create_dynamic_title = {
		tier = kingdom
		name = gzj_title_wang_0000
	}
	create_title_and_vassal_change = {
		type = created
		save_scope_as = guanzhi_give_change
		add_claim_on_loss = no
	}
	scope:new_title = {
		set_landless_title = yes
		set_capital_county = scope:guanzhi_liege.capital_county
		set_de_jure_liege_title = scope:guanzhi_liege.primary_title
		set_no_automatic_claims = yes
		set_can_be_named_after_dynasty = no
		set_variable = { name = guanzhi_is_jue value = yes }
		set_variable = { name = guanzhi_jue_wang value = yes }
		change_title_holder = {
			holder = scope:recipient
			change = scope:guanzhi_give_change
		}
		generate_coa = yes
	}
	scope:recipient = {
		change_liege = {
			liege = scope:guanzhi_liege
			change = scope:guanzhi_give_change
		}
	}
	resolve_title_and_vassal_change = scope:guanzhi_give_change
	scope:new_title = {
		if = {
			limit = { is_title_created = yes }
			debug_log = "GUANZHI diag jue: title CREATED"
		}
		else = {
			debug_log = "GUANZHI diag jue: title NOT_CREATED"
		}
	}
	scope:recipient = {
		add_trait = gzj_wang_0000
		add_character_flag = guanzhi_jue_wang_0000
		add_character_flag = guanzhi_jueholder

		if = {
			limit = { exists = this.var:guanzhi_office_civil_title }
			set_primary_title_to = this.var:guanzhi_office_civil_title
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { exists = this.var:guanzhi_office_military_title }
			set_primary_title_to = this.var:guanzhi_office_military_title
		}
	}
	debug_log = "GUANZHI jue granted"
}

guanzhi_jue_grant_wang_0044 = {
	save_scope_as = guanzhi_liege
	guanzhi_clear_jue_effect = yes
	create_dynamic_title = {
		tier = kingdom
		name = gzj_title_wang_0044
	}
	create_title_and_vassal_change = {
		type = created
		save_scope_as = guanzhi_give_change
		add_claim_on_loss = no
	}
	scope:new_title = {
		set_landless_title = yes
		set_capital_county = scope:guanzhi_liege.capital_county
		set_de_jure_liege_title = scope:guanzhi_liege.primary_title
		set_no_automatic_claims = yes
		set_can_be_named_after_dynasty = no
		set_variable = { name = guanzhi_is_jue value = yes }
		set_variable = { name = guanzhi_jue_wang value = yes }
		change_title_holder = {
			holder = scope:recipient
			change = scope:guanzhi_give_change
		}
		generate_coa = yes
	}
	scope:recipient = {
		change_liege = {
			liege = scope:guanzhi_liege
			change = scope:guanzhi_give_change
		}
	}
	resolve_title_and_vassal_change = scope:guanzhi_give_change
	scope:new_title = {
		if = {
			limit = { is_title_created = yes }
			debug_log = "GUANZHI diag jue: title CREATED"
		}
		else = {
			debug_log = "GUANZHI diag jue: title NOT_CREATED"
		}
	}
	scope:recipient = {
		add_trait = gzj_wang_0044
		add_character_flag = guanzhi_jue_wang_0044
		add_character_flag = guanzhi_jueholder

		if = {

		type = created
		save_scope_as = guanzhi_give_change
		add_claim_on_loss = no
	}
	scope:new_title = {
		set_landless_title = yes
		set_capital_county = scope:guanzhi_liege.capital_county
		set_de_jure_liege_title = scope:guanzhi_liege.primary_title
		set_no_automatic_claims = yes
		set_can_be_named_after_dynasty = no
		set_variable = { name = guanzhi_is_jue value = yes }
		set_variable = { name = guanzhi_jue_wang value = yes }

			holder = scope:recipient
			change = scope:guanzhi_give_change
		}
		generate_coa = yes

		change_liege = {
			liege = scope:guanzhi_liege
			change = scope:guanzhi_give_change
		}
	}
	resolve_title_and_vassal_change = scope:guanzhi_give_change
	scope:new_title = {
		if = {
			limit = { is_title_created = yes }
			debug_log = "GUANZHI diag jue: title CREATED"
		}

guanzhi_jue_grant_xian_0025 = {
	save_scope_as = guanzhi_liege
	guanzhi_clear_jue_effect = yes
	create_dynamic_title = {
		tier = duchy
		name = gzj_title_xian_0025
	}
	create_title_and_vassal_change = {
		type = created
		save_scope_as = guanzhi_give_change
		add_claim_on_loss = no
	}
	scope:new_title = {
		set_landless_title = yes
		set_capital_county = scope:guanzhi_liege.capital_county
		set_de_jure_liege_title = scope:guanzhi_liege.primary_title
		set_no_automatic_claims = yes
		set_can_be_named_after_dynasty = no
		set_variable = { name = guanzhi_is_jue value = yes }
		set_variable = { name = guanzhi_jue_xianhou value = yes }
		change_title_holder = {
			holder = scope:recipient
			change = scope:guanzhi_give_change
		}
		generate_coa = yes
	}
	scope:recipient = {
		change_liege = {
			liege = scope:guanzhi_liege
			change = scope:guanzhi_give_change
		}
	}
	resolve_title_and_vassal_change = scope:guanzhi_give_change
	scope:new_title = {
		if = {
			limit = { is_title_created = yes }
			debug_log = "GUANZHI diag jue: title CREATED"
		}
		else = {
			debug_log = "GUANZHI diag jue: title NOT_CREATED"
		}
	}
	scope:recipient = {
		add_trait = gzj_xian_0025
		add_character_flag = guanzhi_jue_xian_0025
		add_character_flag = guanzhi_jueholder

		if = {
			limit = { exists = this.var:guanzhi_office_civil_title }
			set_primary_title_to = this.var:guanzhi_office_civil_title
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { exists = this.var:guanzhi_office_military_title }
			set_primary_title_to = this.var:guanzhi_office_military_title
		}
	}
	debug_log = "GUANZHI jue granted"
}

	}

		type = created
		save_scope_as = guanzhi_give_change
		add_claim_on_loss = no
	}
	scope:new_title = {
		set_landless_title = yes
		set_capital_county = scope:guanzhi_liege.capital_county
		set_de_jure_liege_title = scope:guanzhi_liege.primary_title
		set_no_automatic_claims = yes

		set_variable = { name = guanzhi_is_jue value = yes }
		set_variable = { name = guanzhi_jue_xianhou value = yes }

			holder = scope:recipient
			change = scope:guanzhi_give_change
		}
		generate_coa = yes
	}

		change_liege = {
			liege = scope:guanzhi_liege
			change = scope:guanzhi_give_change
		}
	}
	resolve_title_and_vassal_change = scope:guanzhi_give_change

		if = {
			limit = { is_title_created = yes }
			debug_log = "GUANZHI diag jue: title CREATED"

	}

		type = created
		save_scope_as = guanzhi_give_change
		add_claim_on_loss = no
	}
	scope:new_title = {
		set_landless_title = yes
		set_capital_county = scope:guanzhi_liege.capital_county
		set_de_jure_liege_title = scope:guanzhi_liege.primary_title

			holder = scope:recipient
			change = scope:guanzhi_give_change
		}
		generate_coa = yes
	}

		change_liege = {
			liege = scope:guanzhi_liege
			change = scope:guanzhi_give_change
		}
	}
	resolve_title_and_vassal_change = scope:guanzhi_give_change

			debug_log = "GUANZHI diag jue: title CREATED"

		save_scope_as = guanzhi_give_change
		add_claim_on_loss = no
	}

		set_landless_title = yes
		set_capital_county = scope:guanzhi_liege.capital_county
		set_de_jure_liege_title = scope:guanzhi_liege.primary_title

		change_liege = {

			change = scope:guanzhi_give_change
		}
	}
	resolve_title_and_vassal_change = scope:guanzhi_give_change

	}

		type = created
		save_scope_as = guanzhi_give_change
		add_claim_on_loss = no
	}
	scope:new_title = {
		set_landless_title = yes
		set_capital_county = scope:guanzhi_liege.capital_county
		set_de_jure_liege_title = scope:guanzhi_liege.primary_title

	}

		change_liege = {
			liege = scope:guanzhi_liege
			change = scope:guanzhi_give_change
		}
	}
	resolve_title_and_vassal_change = scope:guanzhi_give_change

			debug_log = "GUANZHI diag jue: title CREATED"

		save_scope_as = guanzhi_give_change
		add_claim_on_loss = no
	}
	scope:new_title = {
		set_landless_title = yes
		set_capital_county = scope:guanzhi_liege.capital_county
		set_de_jure_liege_title = scope:guanzhi_liege.primary_title
		set_no_automatic_claims = yes
		set_can_be_named_after_dynasty = no
		set_variable = { name = guanzhi_is_jue value = yes }
		set_variable = { name = guanzhi_jue_xianhou value = yes }
		change_title_holder = {
			holder = scope:recipient
			change = scope:guanzhi_give_change
		}
		generate_coa = yes
	}
	scope:recipient = {
		change_liege = {
			liege = scope:guanzhi_liege
			change = scope:guanzhi_give_change
		}
	}
	resolve_title_and_vassal_change = scope:guanzhi_give_change
	scope:new_title = {
		if = {
			limit = { is_title_created = yes }
			debug_log = "GUANZHI diag jue: title CREATED"
		}
		else = {
			debug_log = "GUANZHI diag jue: title NOT_CREATED"
		}
	}
	scope:recipient = {
		add_trait = gzj_xian_0241
		add_character_flag = guanzhi_jue_xian_0241
		add_character_flag = guanzhi_jueholder

		if = {
			limit = { exists = this.var:guanzhi_office_civil_title }
			set_primary_title_to = this.var:guanzhi_office_civil_title
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { exists = this.var:guanzhi_office_military_title }
			set_primary_title_to = this.var:guanzhi_office_military_title
		}

	}

		type = created
		save_scope_as = guanzhi_give_change
		add_claim_on_loss = no
	}
	scope:new_title = {
		set_landless_title = yes
		set_capital_county = scope:guanzhi_liege.capital_county
		set_de_jure_liege_title = scope:guanzhi_liege.primary_title

		change_liege = {
			liege = scope:guanzhi_liege
			change = scope:guanzhi_give_change
		}
	}
	resolve_title_and_vassal_change = scope:guanzhi_give_change

		name = gzj_title_xian_0349
	}
	create_title_and_vassal_change = {
		type = created
		save_scope_as = guanzhi_give_change
		add_claim_on_loss = no
	}
	scope:new_title = {
		set_landless_title = yes
		set_capital_county = scope:guanzhi_liege.capital_county
		set_de_jure_liege_title = scope:guanzhi_liege.primary_title
		set_no_automatic_claims = yes
		set_can_be_named_after_dynasty = no
		set_variable = { name = guanzhi_is_jue value = yes }
		set_variable = { name = guanzhi_jue_xianhou value = yes }
		change_title_holder = {
			holder = scope:recipient
			change = scope:guanzhi_give_change
		}
		generate_coa = yes
	}
	scope:recipient = {
		change_liege = {
			liege = scope:guanzhi_liege
			change = scope:guanzhi_give_change
		}
	}
	resolve_title_and_vassal_change = scope:guanzhi_give_change
	scope:new_title = {
		if = {
			limit = { is_title_created = yes }
			debug_log = "GUANZHI diag jue: title CREATED"
		}
		else = {
			debug_log = "GUANZHI diag jue: title NOT_CREATED"
		}
	}
	scope:recipient = {
		add_trait = gzj_xian_0349
		add_character_flag = guanzhi_jue_xian_0349
		add_character_flag = guanzhi_jueholder

		if = {
			limit = { exists = this.var:guanzhi_office_civil_title }
			set_primary_title_to = this.var:guanzhi_office_civil_title
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { exists = this.var:guanzhi_office_military_title }
			set_primary_title_to = this.var:guanzhi_office_military_title
		}
	}
	debug_log = "GUANZHI jue granted"
}

		name = gzj_title_xian_0403
	}
	create_title_and_vassal_change = {
		type = created
		save_scope_as = guanzhi_give_change
		add_claim_on_loss = no
	}
	scope:new_title = {
		set_landless_title = yes
		set_capital_county = scope:guanzhi_liege.capital_county
		set_de_jure_liege_title = scope:guanzhi_liege.primary_title
		set_no_automatic_claims = yes
		set_can_be_named_after_dynasty = no
		set_variable = { name = guanzhi_is_jue value = yes }
		set_variable = { name = guanzhi_jue_xianhou value = yes }
		change_title_holder = {
			holder = scope:recipient
			change = scope:guanzhi_give_change
		}
		generate_coa = yes
	}
	scope:recipient = {
		change_liege = {
			liege = scope:guanzhi_liege
			change = scope:guanzhi_give_change
		}
	}
	resolve_title_and_vassal_change = scope:guanzhi_give_change
	scope:new_title = {
		if = {
			limit = { is_title_created = yes }
			debug_log = "GUANZHI diag jue: title CREATED"
		}
		else = {
			debug_log = "GUANZHI diag jue: title NOT_CREATED"
		}
	}
	scope:recipient = {
		add_trait = gzj_xian_0403
		add_character_flag = guanzhi_jue_xian_0403
		add_character_flag = guanzhi_jueholder

		if = {
			limit = { exists = this.var:guanzhi_office_civil_title }
			set_primary_title_to = this.var:guanzhi_office_civil_title
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { exists = this.var:guanzhi_office_military_title }
			set_primary_title_to = this.var:guanzhi_office_military_title
		}
	}
	debug_log = "GUANZHI jue granted"
}

		name = gzj_title_xian_0457
	}
	create_title_and_vassal_change = {
		type = created
		save_scope_as = guanzhi_give_change
		add_claim_on_loss = no
	}
	scope:new_title = {
		set_landless_title = yes
		set_capital_county = scope:guanzhi_liege.capital_county
		set_de_jure_liege_title = scope:guanzhi_liege.primary_title
		set_no_automatic_claims = yes
		set_can_be_named_after_dynasty = no
		set_variable = { name = guanzhi_is_jue value = yes }
		set_variable = { name = guanzhi_jue_xianhou value = yes }
		change_title_holder = {
			holder = scope:recipient
			change = scope:guanzhi_give_change
		}
		generate_coa = yes
	}
	scope:recipient = {
		change_liege = {
			liege = scope:guanzhi_liege
			change = scope:guanzhi_give_change
		}
	}
	resolve_title_and_vassal_change = scope:guanzhi_give_change
	scope:new_title = {
		if = {
			limit = { is_title_created = yes }
			debug_log = "GUANZHI diag jue: title CREATED"
		}
		else = {
			debug_log = "GUANZHI diag jue: title NOT_CREATED"
		}
	}
	scope:recipient = {
		add_trait = gzj_xian_0457
		add_character_flag = guanzhi_jue_xian_0457
		add_character_flag = guanzhi_jueholder

		if = {
			limit = { exists = this.var:guanzhi_office_civil_title }
			set_primary_title_to = this.var:guanzhi_office_civil_title
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { exists = this.var:guanzhi_office_military_title }
			set_primary_title_to = this.var:guanzhi_office_military_title
		}
	}
	debug_log = "GUANZHI jue granted"
}

		tier = duchy
		name = gzj_title_xian_0619
	}
	create_title_and_vassal_change = {
		type = created
		save_scope_as = guanzhi_give_change
		add_claim_on_loss = no
	}
	scope:new_title = {
		set_landless_title = yes
		set_capital_county = scope:guanzhi_liege.capital_county
		set_de_jure_liege_title = scope:guanzhi_liege.primary_title
		set_no_automatic_claims = yes
		set_can_be_named_after_dynasty = no
		set_variable = { name = guanzhi_is_jue value = yes }
		set_variable = { name = guanzhi_jue_xianhou value = yes }
		change_title_holder = {
			holder = scope:recipient
			change = scope:guanzhi_give_change
		}
		generate_coa = yes
	}
	scope:recipient = {
		change_liege = {
			liege = scope:guanzhi_liege
			change = scope:guanzhi_give_change
		}
	}
	resolve_title_and_vassal_change = scope:guanzhi_give_change
	scope:new_title = {
		if = {
			limit = { is_title_created = yes }
			debug_log = "GUANZHI diag jue: title CREATED"
		}
		else = {
			debug_log = "GUANZHI diag jue: title NOT_CREATED"
		}
	}
	scope:recipient = {
		add_trait = gzj_xian_0619
		add_character_flag = guanzhi_jue_xian_0619
		add_character_flag = guanzhi_jueholder

		if = {
			limit = { exists = this.var:guanzhi_office_civil_title }
			set_primary_title_to = this.var:guanzhi_office_civil_title
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { exists = this.var:guanzhi_office_military_title }
			set_primary_title_to = this.var:guanzhi_office_military_title
		}
	}
	debug_log = "GUANZHI jue granted"
}

	guanzhi_clear_jue_effect = yes
	create_dynamic_title = {
		tier = duchy
		name = gzj_title_xian_0673
	}
	create_title_and_vassal_change = {
		type = created
		save_scope_as = guanzhi_give_change
		add_claim_on_loss = no
	}
	scope:new_title = {
		set_landless_title = yes
		set_capital_county = scope:guanzhi_liege.capital_county
		set_de_jure_liege_title = scope:guanzhi_liege.primary_title
		set_no_automatic_claims = yes
		set_can_be_named_after_dynasty = no
		set_variable = { name = guanzhi_is_jue value = yes }
		set_variable = { name = guanzhi_jue_xianhou value = yes }
		change_title_holder = {
			holder = scope:recipient
			change = scope:guanzhi_give_change
		}
		generate_coa = yes
	}
	scope:recipient = {
		change_liege = {
			liege = scope:guanzhi_liege
			change = scope:guanzhi_give_change
		}
	}
	resolve_title_and_vassal_change = scope:guanzhi_give_change
	scope:new_title = {
		if = {
			limit = { is_title_created = yes }
			debug_log = "GUANZHI diag jue: title CREATED"
		}
		else = {
			debug_log = "GUANZHI diag jue: title NOT_CREATED"
		}
	}
	scope:recipient = {
		add_trait = gzj_xian_0673
		add_character_flag = guanzhi_jue_xian_0673
		add_character_flag = guanzhi_jueholder

		if = {
			limit = { exists = this.var:guanzhi_office_civil_title }
			set_primary_title_to = this.var:guanzhi_office_civil_title
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { exists = this.var:guanzhi_office_military_title }
			set_primary_title_to = this.var:guanzhi_office_military_title
		}
	}
	debug_log = "GUANZHI jue granted"
}

		type = created
		save_scope_as = guanzhi_give_change
		add_claim_on_loss = no
	}

		set_capital_county = scope:guanzhi_liege.capital_county

			change = scope:guanzhi_give_change
		}

guanzhi_jue_grant_xian_0727 = {
	save_scope_as = guanzhi_liege
	guanzhi_clear_jue_effect = yes
	create_dynamic_title = {
		tier = duchy
		name = gzj_title_xian_0727
	}
	create_title_and_vassal_change = {
		type = created
		save_scope_as = guanzhi_give_change
		add_claim_on_loss = no
	}
	scope:new_title = {
		set_landless_title = yes
		set_capital_county = scope:guanzhi_liege.capital_county
		set_de_jure_liege_title = scope:guanzhi_liege.primary_title
		set_no_automatic_claims = yes
		set_can_be_named_after_dynasty = no
		set_variable = { name = guanzhi_is_jue value = yes }
		set_variable = { name = guanzhi_jue_xianhou value = yes }
		change_title_holder = {
			holder = scope:recipient
			change = scope:guanzhi_give_change
		}
		generate_coa = yes
	}
	scope:recipient = {
		change_liege = {
			liege = scope:guanzhi_liege
			change = scope:guanzhi_give_change
		}
	}
	resolve_title_and_vassal_change = scope:guanzhi_give_change
	scope:new_title = {
		if = {
			limit = { is_title_created = yes }
			debug_log = "GUANZHI diag jue: title CREATED"
		}
		else = {
			debug_log = "GUANZHI diag jue: title NOT_CREATED"
		}
	}
	scope:recipient = {
		add_trait = gzj_xian_0727
		add_character_flag = guanzhi_jue_xian_0727
		add_character_flag = guanzhi_jueholder

		if = {
			limit = { exists = this.var:guanzhi_office_civil_title }
			set_primary_title_to = this.var:guanzhi_office_civil_title
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { exists = this.var:guanzhi_office_military_title }
			set_primary_title_to = this.var:guanzhi_office_military_title
		}
	}
	debug_log = "GUANZHI jue granted"
}

guanzhi_jue_grant_xian_0749 = {
	save_scope_as = guanzhi_liege
	guanzhi_clear_jue_effect = yes
	create_dynamic_title = {
		tier = duchy
		name = gzj_title_xian_0749
	}
	create_title_and_vassal_change = {
		type = created
		save_scope_as = guanzhi_give_change
		add_claim_on_loss = no
	}
	scope:new_title = {
		set_landless_title = yes
		set_capital_county = scope:guanzhi_liege.capital_county
		set_de_jure_liege_title = scope:guanzhi_liege.primary_title
		set_no_automatic_claims = yes
		set_can_be_named_after_dynasty = no
		set_variable = { name = guanzhi_is_jue value = yes }
		set_variable = { name = guanzhi_jue_xianhou value = yes }
		change_title_holder = {
			holder = scope:recipient
			change = scope:guanzhi_give_change
		}
		generate_coa = yes
	}
	scope:recipient = {
		change_liege = {
			liege = scope:guanzhi_liege
			change = scope:guanzhi_give_change
		}
	}
	resolve_title_and_vassal_change = scope:guanzhi_give_change
	scope:new_title = {
		if = {
			limit = { is_title_created = yes }
			debug_log = "GUANZHI diag jue: title CREATED"
		}
		else = {

guanzhi_jue_grant_xian_0792 = {
	save_scope_as = guanzhi_liege
	guanzhi_clear_jue_effect = yes
	create_dynamic_title = {
		tier = duchy
		name = gzj_title_xian_0792
	}
	create_title_and_vassal_change = {
		type = created
		save_scope_as = guanzhi_give_change
		add_claim_on_loss = no
	}
	scope:new_title = {
		set_landless_title = yes
		set_capital_county = scope:guanzhi_liege.capital_county
		set_de_jure_liege_title = scope:guanzhi_liege.primary_title
		set_no_automatic_claims = yes
		set_can_be_named_after_dynasty = no
		set_variable = { name = guanzhi_is_jue value = yes }
		set_variable = { name = guanzhi_jue_xianhou value = yes }
		change_title_holder = {
			holder = scope:recipient
			change = scope:guanzhi_give_change
		}
		generate_coa = yes
	}
	scope:recipient = {
		change_liege = {
			liege = scope:guanzhi_liege
			change = scope:guanzhi_give_change
		}
	}
	resolve_title_and_vassal_change = scope:guanzhi_give_change
	scope:new_title = {
		if = {
			limit = { is_title_created = yes }
			debug_log = "GUANZHI diag jue: title CREATED"
		}
		else = {
			debug_log = "GUANZHI diag jue: title NOT_CREATED"
		}

		add_character_flag = guanzhi_jueholder

	guanzhi_clear_jue_effect = yes
	create_dynamic_title = {
		tier = duchy
		name = gzj_title_xian_0932
	}
	create_title_and_vassal_change = {
		type = created
		save_scope_as = guanzhi_give_change
		add_claim_on_loss = no
	}
	scope:new_title = {
		set_landless_title = yes
		set_capital_county = scope:guanzhi_liege.capital_county
		set_de_jure_liege_title = scope:guanzhi_liege.primary_title
		set_no_automatic_claims = yes
		set_can_be_named_after_dynasty = no
		set_variable = { name = guanzhi_is_jue value = yes }
		set_variable = { name = guanzhi_jue_xianhou value = yes }
		change_title_holder = {
			holder = scope:recipient
			change = scope:guanzhi_give_change
		}
		generate_coa = yes
	}
	scope:recipient = {
		change_liege = {
			liege = scope:guanzhi_liege
			change = scope:guanzhi_give_change
		}
	}
	resolve_title_and_vassal_change = scope:guanzhi_give_change
	scope:new_title = {
		if = {
			limit = { is_title_created = yes }
			debug_log = "GUANZHI diag jue: title CREATED"
		}
		else = {
			debug_log = "GUANZHI diag jue: title NOT_CREATED"
		}
	}
	scope:recipient = {
		add_trait = gzj_xian_0932
		add_character_flag = guanzhi_jue_xian_0932
		add_character_flag = guanzhi_jueholder

		if = {
			limit = { exists = this.var:guanzhi_office_civil_title }
			set_primary_title_to = this.var:guanzhi_office_civil_title
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { exists = this.var:guanzhi_office_military_title }
			set_primary_title_to = this.var:guanzhi_office_military_title
		}
	}
	debug_log = "GUANZHI jue granted"
}

guanzhi_jue_grant_xian_0986 = {
	save_scope_as = guanzhi_liege
	guanzhi_clear_jue_effect = yes
	create_dynamic_title = {
		tier = duchy
		name = gzj_title_xian_0986
	}
	create_title_and_vassal_change = {
		type = created
		save_scope_as = guanzhi_give_change
		add_claim_on_loss = no
	}
	scope:new_title = {
		set_landless_title = yes
		set_capital_county = scope:guanzhi_liege.capital_county
		set_de_jure_liege_title = scope:guanzhi_liege.primary_title
		set_no_automatic_claims = yes
		set_can_be_named_after_dynasty = no
		set_variable = { name = guanzhi_is_jue value = yes }
		set_variable = { name = guanzhi_jue_xianhou value = yes }
		change_title_holder = {
			holder = scope:recipient
			change = scope:guanzhi_give_change
		}
		generate_coa = yes
	}
	scope:recipient = {
		change_liege = {
			liege = scope:guanzhi_liege
			change = scope:guanzhi_give_change
		}
	}
	resolve_title_and_vassal_change = scope:guanzhi_give_change
	scope:new_title = {
		if = {
			limit = { is_title_created = yes }
			debug_log = "GUANZHI diag jue: title CREATED"
		}
		else = {
			debug_log = "GUANZHI diag jue: title NOT_CREATED"
		}
	}
	scope:recipient = {
		add_trait = gzj_xian_0986
		add_character_flag = guanzhi_jue_xian_0986
		add_character_flag = guanzhi_jueholder

		if = {
			limit = { exists = this.var:guanzhi_office_civil_title }
			set_primary_title_to = this.var:guanzhi_office_civil_title
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { exists = this.var:guanzhi_office_military_title }
			set_primary_title_to = this.var:guanzhi_office_military_title
		}
	}
	debug_log = "GUANZHI jue granted"
}

	guanzhi_clear_jue_effect = yes
	create_dynamic_title = {
		tier = duchy
		name = gzj_title_xian_1040
	}
	create_title_and_vassal_change = {
		type = created
		save_scope_as = guanzhi_give_change
		add_claim_on_loss = no
	}
	scope:new_title = {
		set_landless_title = yes
		set_capital_county = scope:guanzhi_liege.capital_county
		set_de_jure_liege_title = scope:guanzhi_liege.primary_title
		set_no_automatic_claims = yes
		set_can_be_named_after_dynasty = no
		set_variable = { name = guanzhi_is_jue value = yes }
		set_variable = { name = guanzhi_jue_xianhou value = yes }
		change_title_holder = {
			holder = scope:recipient
			change = scope:guanzhi_give_change
		}
		generate_coa = yes
	}
	scope:recipient = {
		change_liege = {
			liege = scope:guanzhi_liege
			change = scope:guanzhi_give_change
		}
	}
	resolve_title_and_vassal_change = scope:guanzhi_give_change
	scope:new_title = {
		if = {
			limit = { is_title_created = yes }
			debug_log = "GUANZHI diag jue: title CREATED"
		}
		else = {
			debug_log = "GUANZHI diag jue: title NOT_CREATED"
		}
	}
	scope:recipient = {
		add_trait = gzj_xian_1040
		add_character_flag = guanzhi_jue_xian_1040
		add_character_flag = guanzhi_jueholder

		if = {
			limit = { exists = this.var:guanzhi_office_civil_title }
			set_primary_title_to = this.var:guanzhi_office_civil_title
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { exists = this.var:guanzhi_office_military_title }
			set_primary_title_to = this.var:guanzhi_office_military_title
		}
	}
	debug_log = "GUANZHI jue granted"
}

		add_claim_on_loss = no
	}

			change = scope:guanzhi_give_change

guanzhi_jue_grant_xian_1094 = {
	save_scope_as = guanzhi_liege
	guanzhi_clear_jue_effect = yes
	create_dynamic_title = {
		tier = duchy
		name = gzj_title_xian_1094
	}
	create_title_and_vassal_change = {
		type = created
		save_scope_as = guanzhi_give_change
		add_claim_on_loss = no
	}
	scope:new_title = {
		set_landless_title = yes
		set_capital_county = scope:guanzhi_liege.capital_county
		set_de_jure_liege_title = scope:guanzhi_liege.primary_title
		set_no_automatic_claims = yes
		set_can_be_named_after_dynasty = no
		set_variable = { name = guanzhi_is_jue value = yes }
		set_variable = { name = guanzhi_jue_xianhou value = yes }
		change_title_holder = {
			holder = scope:recipient
			change = scope:guanzhi_give_change
		}
		generate_coa = yes
	}
	scope:recipient = {
		change_liege = {
			liege = scope:guanzhi_liege
			change = scope:guanzhi_give_change
		}
	}
	resolve_title_and_vassal_change = scope:guanzhi_give_change
	scope:new_title = {
		if = {
			limit = { is_title_created = yes }
			debug_log = "GUANZHI diag jue: title CREATED"
		}
		else = {
			debug_log = "GUANZHI diag jue: title NOT_CREATED"
		}
	}
	scope:recipient = {
		add_trait = gzj_xian_1094
		add_character_flag = guanzhi_jue_xian_1094
		add_character_flag = guanzhi_jueholder

		if = {
			limit = { exists = this.var:guanzhi_office_civil_title }
			set_primary_title_to = this.var:guanzhi_office_civil_title
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { exists = this.var:guanzhi_office_military_title }
			set_primary_title_to = this.var:guanzhi_office_military_title
		}
	}
	debug_log = "GUANZHI jue granted"
}

guanzhi_jue_grant_xian_1148 = {
	save_scope_as = guanzhi_liege
	guanzhi_clear_jue_effect = yes
	create_dynamic_title = {
		tier = duchy
		name = gzj_title_xian_1148
	}
	create_title_and_vassal_change = {
		type = created
		save_scope_as = guanzhi_give_change
		add_claim_on_loss = no
	}
	scope:new_title = {
		set_landless_title = yes
		set_capital_county = scope:guanzhi_liege.capital_county
		set_de_jure_liege_title = scope:guanzhi_liege.primary_title
		set_no_automatic_claims = yes
		set_can_be_named_after_dynasty = no
		set_variable = { name = guanzhi_is_jue value = yes }
		set_variable = { name = guanzhi_jue_xianhou value = yes }
		change_title_holder = {
			holder = scope:recipient
			change = scope:guanzhi_give_change
		}
		generate_coa = yes
	}
	scope:recipient = {
		change_liege = {
			liege = scope:guanzhi_liege
			change = scope:guanzhi_give_change
		}
	}
	resolve_title_and_vassal_change = scope:guanzhi_give_change
	scope:new_title = {
		if = {
			limit = { is_title_created = yes }
			debug_log = "GUANZHI diag jue: title CREATED"
		}
		else = {
			debug_log = "GUANZHI diag jue: title NOT_CREATED"
		}
	}
	scope:recipient = {
		add_trait = gzj_xian_1148
		add_character_flag = guanzhi_jue_xian_1148
		add_character_flag = guanzhi_jueholder

		if = {
			limit = { exists = this.var:guanzhi_office_civil_title }
			set_primary_title_to = this.var:guanzhi_office_civil_title
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { exists = this.var:guanzhi_office_military_title }
			set_primary_title_to = this.var:guanzhi_office_military_title
		}
	}
	debug_log = "GUANZHI jue granted"
}

guanzhi_jue_grant_ting_0000 = {
	save_scope_as = guanzhi_liege
	guanzhi_clear_jue_effect = yes
	create_dynamic_title = {
		tier = county
		name = gzj_title_ting_0000
	}
	create_title_and_vassal_change = {
		type = created
		save_scope_as = guanzhi_give_change
		add_claim_on_loss = no
	}
	scope:new_title = {
		set_landless_title = yes
		set_capital_county = scope:guanzhi_liege.capital_county
		set_de_jure_liege_title = scope:guanzhi_liege.primary_title
		set_no_automatic_claims = yes
		set_can_be_named_after_dynasty = no
		set_variable = { name = guanzhi_is_jue value = yes }
		set_variable = { name = guanzhi_jue_tinghou value = yes }
		change_title_holder = {
			holder = scope:recipient
			change = scope:guanzhi_give_change
		}
		generate_coa = yes
	}
	scope:recipient = {
		change_liege = {
			liege = scope:guanzhi_liege
			change = scope:guanzhi_give_change
		}
	}
	resolve_title_and_vassal_change = scope:guanzhi_give_change
	scope:new_title = {
		if = {
			limit = { is_title_created = yes }
			debug_log = "GUANZHI diag jue: title CREATED"
		}
		else = {
			debug_log = "GUANZHI diag jue: title NOT_CREATED"
		}
	}
	scope:recipient = {
		add_trait = gzj_ting_0000
		add_character_flag = guanzhi_jue_ting_0000
		add_character_flag = guanzhi_jueholder

		if = {
			limit = { exists = this.var:guanzhi_office_civil_title }
			set_primary_title_to = this.var:guanzhi_office_civil_title
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { exists = this.var:guanzhi_office_military_title }
			set_primary_title_to = this.var:guanzhi_office_military_title
		}
	}
	debug_log = "GUANZHI jue granted"
}

guanzhi_jue_grant_ting_0033 = {
	save_scope_as = guanzhi_liege
	guanzhi_clear_jue_effect = yes
	create_dynamic_title = {
		tier = county
		name = gzj_title_ting_0033
	}
	create_title_and_vassal_change = {
		type = created
		save_scope_as = guanzhi_give_change
		add_claim_on_loss = no
	}
	scope:new_title = {
		set_landless_title = yes
		set_capital_county = scope:guanzhi_liege.capital_county
		set_de_jure_liege_title = scope:guanzhi_liege.primary_title
		set_no_automatic_claims = yes
		set_can_be_named_after_dynasty = no
		set_variable = { name = guanzhi_is_jue value = yes }
		set_variable = { name = guanzhi_jue_tinghou value = yes }
		change_title_holder = {
			holder = scope:recipient
			change = scope:guanzhi_give_change
		}
		generate_coa = yes
	}
	scope:recipient = {
		change_liege = {
			liege = scope:guanzhi_liege
			change = scope:guanzhi_give_change
		}
	}
	resolve_title_and_vassal_change = scope:guanzhi_give_change
	scope:new_title = {
		if = {
			limit = { is_title_created = yes }
			debug_log = "GUANZHI diag jue: title CREATED"
		}
		else = {
			debug_log = "GUANZHI diag jue: title NOT_CREATED"

		name = gzj_title_ting_0087
	}
	create_title_and_vassal_change = {
		type = created
		save_scope_as = guanzhi_give_change
		add_claim_on_loss = no
	}
	scope:new_title = {
		set_landless_title = yes
		set_capital_county = scope:guanzhi_liege.capital_county
		set_de_jure_liege_title = scope:guanzhi_liege.primary_title
		set_no_automatic_claims = yes
		set_can_be_named_after_dynasty = no
		set_variable = { name = guanzhi_is_jue value = yes }
		set_variable = { name = guanzhi_jue_tinghou value = yes }
		change_title_holder = {
			holder = scope:recipient
			change = scope:guanzhi_give_change
		}
		generate_coa = yes
	}
	scope:recipient = {
		change_liege = {
			liege = scope:guanzhi_liege
			change = scope:guanzhi_give_change
		}
	}
	resolve_title_and_vassal_change = scope:guanzhi_give_change
	scope:new_title = {
		if = {
			limit = { is_title_created = yes }
			debug_log = "GUANZHI diag jue: title CREATED"
		}
		else = {
			debug_log = "GUANZHI diag jue: title NOT_CREATED"
		}
	}
	scope:recipient = {
		add_trait = gzj_ting_0087
		add_character_flag = guanzhi_jue_ting_0087
		add_character_flag = guanzhi_jueholder

		if = {
			limit = { exists = this.var:guanzhi_office_civil_title }
			set_primary_title_to = this.var:guanzhi_office_civil_title
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { exists = this.var:guanzhi_office_military_title }
			set_primary_title_to = this.var:guanzhi_office_military_title
		}
	}
	debug_log = "GUANZHI jue granted"
}

		tier = county
		name = gzj_title_ting_0120
	}
	create_title_and_vassal_change = {
		type = created
		save_scope_as = guanzhi_give_change
		add_claim_on_loss = no
	}
	scope:new_title = {
		set_landless_title = yes
		set_capital_county = scope:guanzhi_liege.capital_county
		set_de_jure_liege_title = scope:guanzhi_liege.primary_title
		set_no_automatic_claims = yes
		set_can_be_named_after_dynasty = no
		set_variable = { name = guanzhi_is_jue value = yes }
		set_variable = { name = guanzhi_jue_tinghou value = yes }

			holder = scope:recipient
			change = scope:guanzhi_give_change

	}

		change_liege = {
			liege = scope:guanzhi_liege
			change = scope:guanzhi_give_change
		}
	}

			limit = { is_title_created = yes }
